observed.caption:
Juniper, Sedge and Fennel are aboard.
Willow is waiting by the reeds.
observed.title: A wave from Ternhaven · ternhaven
observed.description: The yellow ferry glides to a stop in open water beside Tern Buoy. Juniper the chestnut deer, Sedge the sheep and Fennel the tan rabbit stand together on deck. On Reed Landing, Willow the brown beaver looks up and raises a paw to greet them. Water separates the boat from her bank; the neighbors stay where they are.
